definitions.explanation: A level or grade between beginner and advanced. Used in education, language study, sports, and product classifications.

examples.japanese: {中級|ちゅうきゅう}⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中級|ちゅうきゅう}{向|む}けです。
examples.english: This textbook is aimed at intermediate learners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初級|しょきゅう}→初級：11781_shokyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{中級|ちゅうきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that moving from beginner to intermediate is the hardest part.

notes:
USAGE:
Part of the three-level system ⟦{初級|しょきゅう}→初級：11781_shokyuu⟧ (beginner) → {中級|ちゅうきゅう} (intermediate) → ⟦{上級|じょうきゅう}→上級：11298_joukyuu⟧ (advanced). Very commonly used in language learning contexts in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}{者|しゃ} (intermediate-level person)
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}⟦{編|へん}→〜編：28472_hen⟧ (intermediate volume/section)
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧ (intermediate level)
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}{向|む}け (aimed at intermediate learners)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初級|しょきゅう}→初級：11781_shokyuu⟧: beginner level
- ⟦{上級|じょうきゅう}→上級：11298_joukyuu⟧: advanced level
